· Position relative to SMA100 ($466.56)/SMA200 ($341.00): Above long-term/mid-term trends, maintaining strength.
· 52-week position (75.4%) + Approaching historical highs.
[Momentum Indicators]

· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.2430→0.1388): Improving from negative territory, signaling bullish reversal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Mid-band $475.20): Trading around the mid-band, band width at 12.31% indicates moderate volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($463.21): Based on SMA100, trend weakening if breached.
· Swing resistance ($491.12): Previous high, further upside expected on breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low recovery initiation): Potential for uptrend recovery.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.39x): Movement is supported by volume, increasing confidence.
· Current phase diagnosis (Uptrend): Entering long position due to RSI oversold exit and MACD improvement; stop loss if swing support is broken.
